notes.title: SUPER CELEBRATION SOFTWAVES
notes.notes:
Hello guys.

We come through this announcement to bring great news to all of you ːsteammockingː!


[h2]THE SPECIALTY OF THE EVENT[/h2]
You must be wondering why we do this event, and the answer is simple: [b]we are celebrating 6 years of Softwaves in the market[/b] ːsteamhappyː.

Well, time goes by so fast, right? 6 years have passed since our first release ([i]I remember it like it was yesterday[/i]).

We couldn't let such a special date go unnoticed, and that's why we're doing this super commemorative event, entitled [b]SUPER CELEBRATION SOFTWAVES[/b].


[h2]ABOUT THE EVENT[/h2]
[h3]PART 1 - Tasks[/h3]
From February 11 to February 25, 2023 some of our titles will have some "tasks" to be done by players that will generate rewards. See below the tasks ːsteamsaltyː and their respective rewards ːsteamthumbsupː.

[list]
[*] [b]Freight Simulator[/b]
ːsteamsaltyː Task: Reach the balance of F$1,000,00.00 in the business account.
ːsteamthumbsupː Reward: 01 (one) Steam Activation Key for the game Duty in the Forest [i]OR[/i] 01 (one) Steam Activation Key for the game Island Domination.

[*] [b]Mission Z[/b]
ːsteamsaltyː Task: Finish the mission "The grand finale".
ːsteamthumbsupː Reward: 01 (one) Steam Activation Key for Duty in the Forest [i]OR[/i] 01 (one) Steam Activation Key for Island Domination [i]OR[/i] 01 (one) Steam Activation Key for Transporter Manager Tycoon - Mods on the DLC Road.

[*] [b]Transporter Manager Tycoon[/b]
ːsteamsaltyː Task: Acquire a Warehouse in the game.
ːsteamthumbsupː Reward: 01 (one) Steam Activation Key for Duty in the Forest [i]OR[/i] 01 (one) Steam Activation Key for Island Domination [i]OR[/i] 01 (one) Steam Activation Key for Mission Z: Climates DLC.
[/list]
[i]To get your prize, just send an image proving that you have completed the objective in our community tab on Steam, or by Discord, or by email.[/i]

[h3]PART 2 - Questions and suggestions[/h3]
In all our games, a topic entitled "Questions and Suggestions" was opened, in the "Community Hub" tab, where we will open spaces [b]for users to ask a question[/b] [u]related to the game[/u] or [u]Softwaves[/u], [b]or even send suggestions[/b] for improvement for the game.

The selected questions/suggestions will be answered by the team and [b]we will award the selected ones[/b] ːsteamhappyː, the awards could be, alternatively:

[list]
[*] 01 (one) Steam activation key for the game Duty in the Forest.
[*] 01 (one) Steam activation key for the Island Domination game.
[*] 01 (one) Steam activation key for the Mission Z: Climates DLC.
[*] 01 (one) Steam activation key for the Transporter Manager Tycoon DLC - Mods on the Road.
[/list]
[i]Questions/suggestions will be selected and answered after the event ends on February 26, 2023[/i]

[h2]THE GOOD NEWS[/h2]
For 14 days (starting February 11, 2023) [b]ALL of our titles will be at incredible discounts[/b], [u][b]historic prices, never seen before[/b][/u].

This way, you can buy that game you have on your wishlist (the one you've been waiting for the perfect moment, a super discount), or take the opportunity to get to know some of our other titles, for a very affordable price (we would be right to say unmissable, is not?)

ːsteamthisː [b]Take advantage of unmissable discounts.[/b] ːsteamthisː


[h2]PROJECTIONS FOR THE FUTURE[/h2]
We are working on new titles, soon we will announce them to you.

My boss forgive me, but I can't keep it a secret ːsteamfacepalmː, I'm going to give some spoilers about what's to come: We're working on a new mission game, where you'll have the freedom to choose which adventure you want to face, with customization of equipment and lots of awesome mechanics. 

Also, we're working on a new tycoon game, with tons of management options, and a surprising theme (you'll be blown away).

Soon we will update you about the new titles that are coming ːsteammockingː.


[h2]BUNDLES[/h2]
I don't want to influence anyone to make good choices, but have you seen this? 

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/18987/New_Waves/
https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/24304/All_in__Mission_Z/

In addition, as stated earlier, [b]all our titles are LOW, HISTORICAL PRICES[/b]. Take a look:

notes.title: Free weekend - March 3rd to March 6th
notes.notes:
Hello players.

We are pleased to announce that Freight Simulator is available on Steam's Free Weekend from March 3rd to March 6th, 2022.

It's a great opportunity for you to get to know the game, for free, and fall in love with our franchise. Thinking about new players, who still don't own the game, we decided to implement a historic discount never seen before of 60%. You didn't read it wrong! [b]We actually put a 60% discount on Freight Simulator, but hurry, because it's for a limited time.[/b]

To accompany this incredible moment, [b]we also put HISTORIC DISCOUNTS on our other 2 biggest titles[/b], the [b]Mission Z[/b] and the [b]Transporter Manager Tycoon[/b], take a look about these titles below.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1401750/Mission_Z/
[i]Mission Z is a singleplayer shooter/survival game, where you must complete some missions to complete it, breaking through a giant open world area, with various interactions, enemies, items and collectibles in general.[/i]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1513580/Transporter_Manager_Tycoon/
[i]Transporter Manager Tycoon is the successor to Freight Simulator, in addition to having all the functions of Freight Simulator, Transporter Manager Tycoon allows you to manage the financial market, in addition to having the option to expand your carrier into a distributor, thus being able to buy and sell items, in addition to transporting them. If you are a Freight Simulator lover, you will definitely like Transporter Manager Tycoon.[/i]

[h3] Take the opportunity to follow our page on Steam and stay up to date with all our releases. See more at:[/h3]
https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/softwaves

notes.title: MEGA Update (v2.0.0)
notes.notes:
[i][b] Hello entrepreneurs,
[/b][/i]

[b][h2]Preface:[/h2][/b]
[b]This new update is truly amazing.[/b] 
We had some new ideas for you to have even more fun with the game, fixed some bugs, made many improvements and brought a lot of new things! 

[b]We can consider that the Freight Simulator will become a new game in terms of immersion with this update that completely changed the game.[/b]

[b][h2]General notices:[/h2][/b]
* The functions of this new version are not compatible with previous saves and due to the lack of compatibility we strongly recommend that you start a new save game.
* All users will need to reset a new nickname to chat and participate in the online ranking.

[h1] Check out what we've updated in the game: [/h1]

[h3]- Competitors[/h3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/t9gKwqb.png[/img]

[i]Now to sign contracts you will compete with other companies in the game.[/i]


With [b]more than 25 competitors[/b] the game will be much more fun, with several new opportunities.

Whoever gets the biggest bargain takes the contract, may the best one win!

[h3]- New design to choose from & new design to view features[/h3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/zFRojBA.png[/img]


With this new design, it will be much easier to choose to manage all your items and employees.

We have also added a menu for you to see which employee, bucket or set is connected with the truck and the freight, allowed so that you can [b]manage everything more easily[/b].

[h3]- New images for buckets[/h3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/XUZbAHG.png[/img]


Now the buckets have an image, and it is much [b]easier to recognize[/b] them.

[h3]- Adding women & new characters[/h3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/qHukTxE.png[/img]


Due to a limitation in the initial algorithm of the game we were unable to add women at the launch of the game, we improved the algorithm and [b]now women are also part of the game![/b]

In addition to women, [b]we also added new characters to the game[/b] with new names for employees.

We added a total of 100 possible characters in the game.

[h3]- Freight price will now be equated to cargo[/h3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/gwv8AtZ.png[/img]


Freight [b]prices[/b] will now be [b]based on the value of the cargo[/b] transported, tons and distance. Thus making the game more real and a little more fun.

[h3]- Rare cargoes & contracts[/h3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/UjCAv03.png[/img]


Now you may be lucky enough to find a rare cargo or contract every time new freight or contracts appear.

Rare freight and contracts [b]give more money when transporting[/b].

[h3]- New design icons[/h3]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/OBvsEtZ.png[/img]


We redesigned some icons to make the game [b]more beautiful[/b].

[h3]- New mod tool, allows you to change things in the game[/h3]
This tool is only [b]available[/b] to users of the [b]BETA version[/b]
A tool that allows you to change the names of employees, trucks and buckets.
Soon we will add more mods and a complete tool for you to develop your own mods.

[h3]- New achievements[/h3]
We’ve also added new achievements for you. 

We added a total of [b]11 new achievements[/b].

[h3]Rebalancing[/h3]

[i]We had a great rebalancing throughout the game to make it a little more realistic, but always maintaining the essence of the game.[/i]
[list]
[*] The KMs away from freight and contracts have been readjusted and can now [b]reach up to 4,000KMs[/b].
[*] The number of KMs that a driver can travel has been [b]increased[/b] significantly.
[*] The [b]tons[/b] of freight and contracts were readjusted to a [b]maximum of 60T[/b].
[*] The [b]best bucket[/b] will now be able to load up to [b]60T[/b].
[*] [b]Prices[/b] for [b]trucks and buckets[/b] were [b]readjusted [/b]at the store.
[*] [b]Property[/b] prices/cost/profit have been [b]readjusted[/b].
[*] [b]Value of freight[/b] and [b]contracts[/b] readjusted.
[*] Adjusted [b]employee salary[/b] and hiring rate.
[*] [b]Fuel price [/b]that used to cost F$ 50.00 per liter has been adjusted, each liter will [b]now cost F$ 8.00[/b], with a [b]discount of F$ 0.20 for each level of gas station you own[/b].
[*] [b]Interest [/b]on invested capital that was 0.50% was adjusted to [b]0.25%[/b].
[/list]

[h3]Optimizations[/h3]
[list]
[*] The garage has been optimized and some players who were experiencing lag problems will no longer have this problem.
[*] Significant improvements in game response speed.
[/list]

[h3]Bug fixes[/h3]
[list]
[*] Translation errors in some languages ​​have been corrected according to some suggestions from you.
[*] Bug that the employee did not resign when satisfaction reached 0 has been fixed.
[*] Bug that showed the driver was busy when attached to a truck that was not traveling has been fixed.
[*] Bug that did not show the available sets on the freight screen and corrected contract.
[*] Bug that was not updating the rankings fixed.
[/list]

[u][b]* The functions of this new version are not compatible with previous saves and due to the lack of compatibility we strongly recommend that you start a new save game. *[/b][/u]


[h3]What we have to say[/h3]

Many of these improvements were possible due to the ideas you have given, so we would like to thank all of you who have given us suggestions for improving the game.

The community is very important to us, we listen to everyone and we always try to adapt the game for everyone in the best possible way. If you have any suggestions, comment below.

[b]Version 2.0 of Freight Simulator has arrived to improve the game and make your gameplay much more addictive! It is now available to everyone who owns the game from now on.[/b]



[i][b]Good freights![/b][/i] ːsteamhappyː

notes.title: Update - 1.0.7
notes.notes:
Hello entrepreneurs,

[b]We made some significant changes to the new version that is now available to everyone (v1.0.7)[/b]

With the support of the community we were able to identify several bugs that were interfering with the game and improve parts that had lags. And we also added some things that you suggested.

[list]
[*] [h2]Showing loads on contracts[/h2]
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/nbxan16.png[/img]
Now when accepting a contract you will be able to see the image of what cargo you will carry.

[list]
[*] [h2]New sound effects[/h2]
[/list]
Now the game has a new collection of sound effects in many parts. We believe that this will make the gameplay more enjoyable.

[list]
[*] [h2]Removing lag[/h2]
[/list]
We were able to identify and remove the lag that occurred for some in different parts of the game.

[list]
[*] [h2]Bug fixes and general improvements[/h2]
[/list]
- The freight screen bug, which prevented you from continuing to work when contract freight was delivered, has been resolved.
- The bug that happened when an employee resigned is now resolved.
- The bug that left the freight many days late when coming from contracts has been resolved.
- The bug in contract progress that came with the 1.0.6 update has been fixed.
- The errors in the tutorial that came up with version 1.0.6 have been fixed.
- Crash that was happening for some Windows 7 users is now resolved.

[list]
[*] [h2]Upcoming updates[/h2]
[/list]
We are working on the suggestions left by you, soon we will show a little more of what is being done, but we will advance some things:

[b]- Competitors will soon be in the game.[/b]
You will have competition, there will be new types of freight where you must compete with another company to provide the contractor with the best price.

[b]- Stock market[/b]
We are working in a stock market where you can buy and sell shares of your competitors, being able to earn good money, or lose good money.

[b]- Improved connectivity and ease of use[/b]
We are improving the whole game so that you can connect everywhere easier.

[b]- New achievements[/b]
We are working on new achievements for those who have already achieved them all.

[b]We always want to connect more and more with you, we will improve the game according to the feedback of all users.
If you have any suggestions, comment below.[/b]

Thanks for reading and staying up to date on the game.

[i][b]Good freights![/b][/i]

notes.title: Update - 1.0.6
notes.notes:
Hello entrepreneurs,

[b]We made some significant changes to the new version that is now available to everyone (v1.0.6)[/b]

As feedback from the community we made some changes to improve the gameplay of the game and fixed some bugs, so here's what we've changed and it's already available to all of you:

[list]
[*] [h2]Delete saves[/h2]
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/A0wcYxb.png[/img]
It is now possible to delete the saves, this feature was requested by you and we added it, which now makes it possible to better organize the saves you wish to keep.

[list]
[*] [h2]Freight progress[/h2]
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/Y7Nnafm.png[/img]
Many requested that they could better monitor the delivery of their freight, now the freight has progress, you can check them in the "Shipping" menu in the "Your travels" tab.

[list]
[*] [h2]Game speeds[/h2]
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/kxDeAtT.png[/img]
Now you can control the game at 3 different speeds, thus allowing the game to run according to the time that is best for you.

[list]
[*] [h2]New shortcut buttons[/h2]
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/RJYPmC4.png[/img]
New shortcut buttons are available in the menus: Garage, Shop, Employees and Freight.
We believe that these shortcut buttons will be useful for you to go to various places in an easier way.

[list]
[*] [h2]Bug fixes and general improvements[/h2]
[/list]
- Bug of infinite money in loans and investments fixed.
- Bug of not spending the day automatically fixed.
- Bugs of problems with automatic maintenance done by managers fixed.
- Significant improvements to crashes that were present for some users.
[b]- Slowness issue for some users has been resolved, but we are still working on optimizations to make the game even faster.[/b]
[b]- The compatibility issue that some users of the 64-bit Windows is now resolved.[/b]

[list]
[*] [h2]Upcoming updates[/h2]
[/list]
We are working on the suggestions left by you, soon we will show a little more of what is being done, but we will advance some things:

[b]- Competitors will soon be in the game.[/b]
You will have competition, there will be new types of freight where you must compete with another company to provide the contractor with the best price.

[b]- Stock market[/b]
We are working in a stock market where you can buy and sell shares of your competitors, being able to earn good money, or lose good money.

[b]- Improved connectivity and ease of use[/b]
We are improving the whole game so that you can connect everywhere easier.

Thanks for all the feedback you left in the reviews and comments from the last update

[b]We always want to connect more and more with you, we will improve the game according to the feedback of all users.
If you have any suggestions, comment below.[/b]

Thanks for reading and staying up to date on the game.

[i][b]Good freights![/b][/i]

notes.title: Small update - Launch day
notes.notes:
Hello entrepreneurs,

As feedback from the community we made some small changes to improve the gameplay of the game, so here's what we've changed and it's already available to all of you:

[list]
[*] [h2]Dark mode[/h2]
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/lBy91h6.png[/img]
The dark mode that is in BETA is available in "Settings", to activate it just go to settings, click on it and save.
We made this change due to the large number of users who had complained about the excessive luminosity of the light version.
You can now choose whether to play in a dark version or a light version.

[list]
[*] [h2]When creating a new company you can define whether or not to take care of your personal life[/h2]
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/ykSncgn.png[/img]
This change was made because we received several feedbacks from different people who do not feel interested in taking care of their personal life in the game. So from now on, when creating a new company, if you don't want to take care of your personal life in the game, you will have the option to leave it aside.

[list]
[*] [h2]We add new buttons that take you to other places more easily[/h2]
[/list]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/hfSSsiZ.png[/img]
You can now switch between menus more easily with the new buttons at the top of some pages.
We changed that because we believe it will make the gameplay easier.

[b]We always want to connect more and more with you, we will improve the game according to the feedback of all users.
If you have any suggestions, comment below.[/b]

Thanks for reading and staying up to date on the game.

[i][b]Good freight![/b][/i]
